_meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. Laws change. Every fact carries its source and the date it was checked - re-check before posting.

schema.verified: true only if a source was read on the 'checked' date. generate.py refuses to use false without --include-unverified.
schema.penalty_usd: null when no source stated a USD figure and no dated rate exists for that currency. Never estimated.
schema.tts: the spoken line. Keep under 18 words - the whole script has to fit ~92 words for 32 seconds.
schema.penalty_display: Where the conversion belongs mid-sentence. Falls back to penalty_local plus the USD figure when absent.
schema.hook: Pro Land. cover_head und cover_sub gehen auf Slide 1, spoken in die Tonspur, close auf die Schlusskarte. Fehlt das Feld, nimmt generate.py die Standardformulierung - die aber pro Post variiert werden muss, sonst liest sich der naechste Post wie der letzte.

IDR.source: kein datierter Kurs. Bali-Betraege tragen nur die USD-Zahl, die die Quelle selbst nennt.

measured_wpm.note: Measured on the real Thailand reel: Higgsfield seed_audio, voice Isla, atempo 1.30. Do not assume faster - the first three length estimates for that post were all too optimistic.

facts.title: Vapes
facts.why: Sold openly at home, so tourists pack one without thinking. Police in Bangkok and Phuket check for them specifically.
facts.penalty_local: Fines up to 30,000 THB, and bringing one through customs falls under the Customs Act
facts.tts: Vapes. Banned since twenty fourteen. Thirty thousand baht.
facts.source: terms.law vaping-laws; iamkohchang.com; canibringto.com
facts.penalty_display: Fines up to 30,000 baht, about $900. Bringing one through customs falls under the Customs Act.

facts.title: Flying a drone
facts.why: Two separate registrations, and neither can be finished before you land.
facts.penalty_local: Up to 5 years or 100,000 THB, equipment seized
facts.tts: Flying a drone. Two registrations, or five years.
facts.source: Drone Association Thailand (droneth.or.th); uavwiki.com - CAAT plus NBTC, no-fly 9 km around every airport
facts.penalty_display: Up to 5 years or 100,000 baht, about $3,000, and your equipment seized.

facts.title: Overstaying
facts.why: The daily fine sounds survivable. Getting caught instead of reporting yourself is the expensive part.
facts.penalty_local: 500 THB a day, capped at 20,000 after 40 days. Caught by immigration under a year overstay means a 5-year ban
facts.tts: Overstaying. Report yourself and you pay. Get caught, five-year ban.
facts.source: juslaws.com; tratimmigration.com; legal.co.th - voluntary under 90 days is fine only, no blacklist
facts.penalty_display: 500 baht a day, about $15, capped at 20,000, about $600. Caught by immigration means a five-year ban.

facts.title: Cannabis
facts.why: Buying it is genuinely easy, which is exactly why people misjudge the rest.
facts.penalty_local: Public consumption up to 25,000 THB and 3 months. Taking it out of the country, since 17 June 2026, up to 10 years and 500,000 THB
facts.tts: Cannabis. Buying is legal. Taking it home is ten years.
facts.source: US Embassy Bangkok alert 2026-07-08 (Section 244 Customs Act); Khaosod English; terms.law; thailawonline.com
facts.penalty_display: Public use up to 25,000 baht, about $750. Taking it out of the country, since 17 June 2026, up to ten years and 500,000 baht, about $15,000.

facts.title: Posting about the monarchy
facts.why: Section 112 applies to foreigners, and anyone at all can file the complaint.
facts.penalty_local: 3 to 15 years per count, and every post counts separately
facts.tts: Posting about the monarchy. Three to fifteen years, per post.
facts.source: ARTICLE 19; ilaw.or.th; thailawonline.com
facts.penalty_display: Three to fifteen years per count, and every post counts separately.

facts.title: Smoking on the beach
facts.why: Nobody expects a beach to be a no-smoking zone, and the signs are easy to miss.
facts.penalty_local: Up to a year in prison or 100,000 THB
facts.tts: Smoking on the beach. Twenty-four beaches. Up to a year.
facts.source: SEATCA; Library of Congress Global Legal Monitor; beachnear.me - started at 20 beaches in Nov 2017, now 24 across 15 provinces
facts.penalty_display: Up to a year in prison, or 100,000 baht, about $3,000.

facts.title: Taking coral home
facts.why: A shell in your bag looks like a souvenir until it is found in a national park.
facts.penalty_local: Up to 5 years and 500,000 THB under the National Park Act 2019
facts.tts: Taking coral home. In a national park, five years.
facts.source: National Park Act B.E. 2562 (2019); thailand.go.th; divephiphiisland.com
facts.penalty_display: Up to five years and 500,000 baht, about $15,000, under the National Park Act 2019.

facts.title: Vaping in the wrong place
facts.why: Vapes are legal to own but count as smoking, and the smoke-free zones are wider than people expect.
facts.penalty_local: Import limits: 30 ml open-system or 12 ml closed-system e-liquid. Vaping in a smoke-free area is penalised like smoking
facts.tts: Vaping. Legal to own, fined in any smoke-free zone.
facts.source: vpz.co.uk Bali vaping laws

facts.title: Riding a scooter without the right permit
facts.why: An International Driving Permit for cars is not enough. It has to carry the motorcycle class.
facts.penalty_local: 300,000 to 1,000,000 IDR per missing document. Task force Dharma Dewata has run zero tolerance since April 2026
facts.penalty_display: 300,000 to 1,000,000 rupiah, about $20 to $70, per missing document. And without a valid permit your insurer can refuse the hospital bill, which runs past $20,000 for a serious crash.
facts.tts: Scooters. Your car permit doesn't count, and your insurance knows it.
facts.source: bali.com IDL guide; practicesource.com; shortstaybali.com; myadventuretrips.com

facts.title: Flying a drone
facts.why: Registration is required for every drone since January 2025, including sub-250 gram models.
facts.penalty_local: Up to IDR 5 billion and 5 years for restricted airspace. Perda Bali 12/2024 adds a 5 km exclusion around sacred sites, needing written consent from the local banjar
facts.tts: Drones. Every one needs registering, even the tiny ones.
facts.source: yourhappinesstours.com Bali drone laws 2026; drone-laws.com Indonesia
facts.penalty_display: Up to IDR 5 billion, about $308,000, and 5 years. A 5 km exclusion zone around sacred sites.

facts.title: Bringing any cannabis in
facts.why: CBD oil and a medical card from home count for nothing here. Cannabis sits in the same group as heroin.
facts.penalty_local: Group I narcotic. Possession 4 to 12 years. Over 1 kg plant material or 5 g synthetic: life or the death penalty
facts.tts: Cannabis. Same legal group as heroin. Possession is four years minimum.
facts.source: tripbase.com Indonesia drug laws; yourhappinesstours.com; baliholidaysecrets.com
facts.penalty_display: Possession alone is four to twelve years in Kerobokan. Above a kilo it is life or the firing squad.

facts.title: Small plastic water bottles
facts.why: Every shop used to sell them, and since January they are gone for a reason.
facts.penalty_local: Full ban on bottled water under one litre across Bali since January 2026, plus bags, styrofoam and straws
facts.penalty_display: Banned island-wide since January 2026, along with bags, styrofoam and straws.
facts.tts: Small plastic bottles. Banned island-wide since January.
facts.source: Ocean Gardener 2026 update; villabalisale.com; timeout.com

facts.title: Overstaying
facts.why: One single day over triggers the full daily rate.
facts.penalty_local: IDR 1,000,000 per day up to 60 days. Past 60 days, automatic deportation order
facts.tts: Overstaying. One day over costs a million rupiah.
facts.source: absvisa.com; visa.balieasy.com - USD figure is the source's own
facts.penalty_display: IDR 1,000,000 a day, about $65, up to 60 days. Then automatic deportation.

facts.title: Sacred sites and temples
facts.why: The inner temple areas are closed to non-worshippers, and photos taken the wrong way get people deported.
facts.penalty_local: Deportation, entry ban, and required purification ceremony. Sarong and sash needed past any temple gate
facts.tts: Temples. The inner courtyards are closed to you, and photos get people deported.
facts.source: lovebali.baliprov.go.id (Governor Koster regulations); timeout.com 2025-03-28

facts.title: Vapes
facts.why: The ban reaches passengers who never leave the airport.
facts.penalty_local: Fine raised to S$10,000, with longer maximum jail terms and mandatory caning for importers and traffickers. Applies in transit at Changi
facts.tts: Vapes. Ten thousand dollar fine, and it applies in transit.
facts.source: thevapersguide.com Singapore; ecigone.co.uk; airtraveler.club

facts.title: Flying a drone
facts.why: Registration plus an online training certificate, before the first flight.
facts.penalty_local: S$50,000 and up to 2 years for a first offence, S$100,000 and 5 years for repeats. Registration required above 250 g
facts.tts: Drones. Fifty thousand dollars and two years without the permit.
facts.source: dronesgator.com Singapore; fitcationhq.com; propelrc.com

facts.title: Overstaying
facts.why: Caning enters the picture past 90 days.
facts.penalty_local: Up to 90 days: fine up to S$4,000 and up to 6 months. Beyond 90 days: up to 6 months and a minimum of 3 strokes of the cane, or up to S$6,000 if caning does not apply
facts.tts: Overstaying. Past ninety days that means caning, not a fine.
facts.source: singaporelegaladvice.com

facts.title: Bringing in chewing gum
facts.why: Chewing it is minor. Carrying a pack in counts as importing.
facts.penalty_local: Consuming: fine from S$500. Importing: up to S$10,000 or 2 years
facts.tts: Chewing gum. Bringing a pack in counts as importing it.
facts.source: scansg.com penalties; Wikipedia chewing gum sales ban; fodors.com

facts.title: Littering
facts.why: A dropped receipt is enough.
facts.penalty_local: Up to S$2,000 first offence, up to S$10,000 for each repeat
facts.tts: Littering. Two thousand dollars for a dropped receipt.
facts.source: worldnomads.com; scansg.com penalties

facts.title: Drugs
facts.note: Singapore has the death penalty for trafficking, and tests residents on return. Needs a primary source before it goes in a script.

facts.title: Public conduct rules
facts.note: Unflushed toilets, eating on the MRT and similar are widely repeated online but the amounts vary by source. Check before use.

facts.title: Filming people without asking
facts.why: It is a sexual offence here, not a privacy nuisance, and it applies in the street.
facts.penalty_local: Article 14, Act on Special Cases Concerning the Punishment of Sexual Crimes. Up to 5 years for filming, up to 7 for sharing it, or a fine up to 50,000,000 KRW
facts.tts: Filming strangers. Up to five years, and it counts in public.
facts.source: Act on Special Cases Concerning the Punishment of Sexual Crimes Art. 14; koreaherald.com; pureumlawoffice.com; eng.taeshinlaw.com
facts.penalty_display: Up to five years, seven if you post it, or 50 million won, about $36,500. It counts in public places too.

facts.title: Vaping outside a smoking area
facts.why: Vapes are treated exactly like cigarettes, and the designated areas are marked but easy to walk past.
facts.penalty_local: Instant 100,000 KRW fine. Nicotine liquid above 1 percent is treated as a toxic substance and confiscated, import limit 20 ml
facts.tts: Vaping. Outside a marked smoking area that's an instant fine.
facts.source: roafly.com South Korea tourist laws; roafly.com customs rules
facts.penalty_display: An instant 100,000 won fine, about $73, outside a marked smoking area.

facts.title: Nicotine liquid in your bag
facts.why: Separate problem from where you vape. This one happens at the border.
facts.penalty_local: Import limit 20 ml. Anything above 1 percent (10 mg/ml) is treated as a toxic substance and confiscated
facts.tts: Nicotine liquid. Twenty millilitres, then customs keeps it.
facts.source: roafly.com South Korea airport customs rules
facts.penalty_display: Twenty millilitres maximum, and anything above one percent is confiscated as a toxic substance.

facts.title: Your ADHD or painkiller prescription
facts.why: Ordinary prescriptions from home are controlled narcotics here, and the permit takes weeks.
facts.penalty_local: Adderall and other amphetamines are banned outright with no personal-import exception. Methylphenidate needs an MFDS narcotics import permit applied for 2 to 3 weeks before departure. Without it, treated as narcotics importation
facts.penalty_display: Adderall is banned outright. Concerta and Ritalin need a permit you apply for two to three weeks before you fly.
facts.tts: This one's the answer. Your medication. Adderall is banned, and the permit takes three weeks.
facts.source: nomedic.co South Korea ADHD guide; insight-bridge.co.kr; tripbase.com prescription; MFDS permit process

facts.title: Flying a drone
facts.why: The border zones are far wider than any tourist expects.
facts.penalty_local: No flights within 15 km of the DMZ in the east, 10 km in the west. Up to 1 year or 10 million KRW under February 2026 legislation. Other pilot-rule breaches up to 2 million KRW
facts.tts: Drones. Fifteen kilometres of no-fly zone along the border.
facts.source: drone-laws.com South Korea; dronesgator.com
facts.penalty_display: Up to a year or 10 million won, about $7,300. No-fly runs 15 km from the border in the east.

facts.title: Overstaying
facts.why: One day over is already a violation of the Immigration Control Act.
facts.penalty_local: Fine scaled to the length of overstay, plus possible deportation and re-entry ban. Voluntary departure reduces it
facts.tts: Overstaying. One day over and it's already a criminal violation.
facts.source: visaskorea.com overstay penalty guide

facts.title: Cannabis, even if you smoked it before you came
facts.why: Customs can hair-test you, and a legal smoke at home is still evidence here.
facts.penalty_local: Up to 5 years or 50,000,000 KRW for possession or use. Customs run hair tests, and travellers have been detained on the test alone
facts.tts: Cannabis. They can hair-test you at the airport.
facts.source: Narcotics Control Act; tripbase.com South Korea cannabis; UK FCDO travel advice; cannabisregulations.ai
facts.penalty_display: Up to five years or 50 million won, about $36,500. Customs can hair-test you on arrival.

hook.cover_head: One thing in your carry-on is a narcotics charge in South Korea.
hook.cover_sub: Seven things worth checking before you fly.
hook.spoken: One thing in your carry-on is a narcotics charge in South Korea. Here are seven things to check before you fly.
hook.note: Raetsel-Hook nach dem Japan-Muster (48 Saves auf 2216 Views). Zeigt bewusst auf den Koffer der Leserin statt auf das Foto - bei Korea sind alle sieben verbotenen Dinge entweder bedruckt oder gar kein Gegenstand, ein Bildraetsel waere der 'this bag'-Fehler. Aufloesung auf Slide 5.

facts.title: Nicotine e-liquid
facts.note: Japan regulates nicotine liquid as a pharmaceutical while heated tobacco is sold openly. Needs its own check.

facts.title: Cold and allergy medicine
facts.why: Ordinary pharmacy boxes from home contain ingredients Japan bans outright.
facts.penalty_local: Sudafed, Actifed and Vicks inhalers are banned. Codeine needs a permit applied for before you travel, and a prescription from home does not substitute
facts.tts: Cold medicine. Sudafed and Vicks inhalers are banned outright.
facts.source: Verified for the Japan carousel, see daya/content/2026-08-28-carousel-japan.md

facts.title: Rubbish
facts.why: Almost no public bins, so your rubbish travels with you to a convenience store.
facts.penalty_local: Not a fine in practice, a social rule. Listed because it is the thing tourists get wrong daily
facts.source: Verified for the Japan carousel. No TTS line: it is not a criminal penalty, so it does not belong in a 'banned' script.

facts.title: E-cigarettes
facts.why: A full ban, and it covers carrying and using, not only selling.
facts.penalty_local: Resolution 173/2024/QH15 bans production, transport, storage and use from 14 January 2025. From March 2026 all business and investment activity in e-cigarettes and heated tobacco is banned under the amended Investment Law
facts.tts: E-cigarettes. Banned outright, including just carrying one.
facts.source: vietcetera.com; vinapouches.vn; vietnamck.cz

facts.title: Flying a drone
facts.why: The permit comes from the Ministry of Defence and takes weeks.
facts.penalty_local: Flight permit mandatory, up to 3 weeks to approve, costs roughly 350 to 700 USD. Flying without it: about 20 to 30 million VND
facts.tts: Drones. The permit comes from the Ministry of Defence and takes weeks.
facts.source: authentiktravel.com; ethosspirit.com; drone-laws.com Vietnam

facts.title: Overstaying
facts.why: Fines rise steeply and deportation is automatic for longer overstays.
facts.penalty_local: 1 to 15 days: 500,000 to 2 million VND and a formal warning. Up to 40 million VND at the top end, with mandatory deportation for serious cases
facts.tts: Overstaying. Up to forty million dong, then deportation.
facts.source: vietcetera.com - USD figure is the source's own
facts.penalty_display: 1 to 15 days: 500,000 to 2 million dong. Up to 40 million dong, about $1,519, at the top end.

facts.title: Posting about the state
facts.note: Vietnam prosecutes online speech, but I have no tourist-specific source. Do not write this line unresearched.

facts.title: Temples and pagodas
facts.note: Only etiquette guidance found, no penalty. Do not invent one.

facts.title: Vapes
facts.why: Prohibited as an import, so it is a customs problem before it is anything else.
facts.penalty_local: E-cigarettes and vaping devices are prohibited items on entry
facts.tts: Vapes. A prohibited import, taken off you at customs.
facts.source: UK FCDO travel advice Sri Lanka

facts.title: Flying a drone
facts.note: Sri Lanka requires CAA permits, but I found no figure. Research before use.

facts.title: Overstaying
facts.why: The ETA is only 30 days and the daily fine adds up fast.
facts.penalty_local: Roughly LKR 5,000 to 10,000 per day, possible detention, deportation at your own expense and a future entry ban
facts.tts: Overstaying. Deportation at your own expense, plus an entry ban.
facts.source: akbartravels.com Sri Lanka visa rules; UK FCDO travel advice
facts.note: The daily figure is given as a range by the source. Prefer the consequence over the number on screen.

facts.title: Buddha tattoos and images
facts.why: A tattoo you have had for years can stop you at the border.
facts.penalty_local: Visitors with a visible Buddha tattoo have been refused entry, arrested or deported
facts.tts: Buddha tattoos. People get refused entry at the border for them.
facts.source: UK FCDO travel advice Sri Lanka; tikalanka.com local laws

facts.title: Turning your back on a Buddha statue
facts.note: Widely repeated as a selfie offence. Find the actual charge before using it.
